crossRefs.note: They traveled from Bethel. There was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and Rachel travailed. She had hard labor.
We said to my lord, ‘We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead…
The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.
“Benjamin is a ravenous wolf. In the morning he will devour the prey. At evening he will divide the plunder.”

people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

translations.web: Of the children of Benjamin, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
translations.bsb: From the sons of Benjamin, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
translations.kjv: Of the children of Benjamin, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
translations.asv: Of the children of Benjamin, their generations, by their families, by their fathers' houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
